definitions: Of a somewhat high temperature, often but not always connoting that the high temperature is pleasant rather than uncomfortable.
To become warm, to heat up.

A hard external covering of an animal.
The calcareous or chitinous external covering of mollusks, crustaceans, and some other invertebrates.
The calcareous or chitinous external covering of mollusks, crustaceans, and some other invertebrates.
To remove the outer covering or shell of something.
To bombard, to fire projectiles at, especially with artillery.

blocks.text: Shell is a 2024 American black comedy body horror film directed by Max Minghella, written by Jack Stanley, and starring Elisabeth Moss, Kate Hudson, Kaia Gerber and Elizabeth Berkley.
